tables.title: Table 1: all paper configurations (tiers x configs)

arms.label: M1 (Mamba-1, d256, anchor)
arms.desc: official Mamba-1 (mamba_ssm), N 128, 2 layers, expand 2, per-channel Δ, low-rank Δ projection; the budget anchor

arms.label: M2 (Mamba-2, d320/h64, stock-above)
arms.desc: official Mamba-2, N 128, 2 layers, expand 2, headdim 64 (10 heads), ngroups 1; smallest stock width above M1

arms.label: M3 (Mamba-3 upstream anonymous-revision-13, d320/h64, stock-above)
arms.desc: official Mamba-3 (upstream anonymous-revision-13), N 128, 2 layers, expand 2, headdim 64 (10 heads), ngroups 1; smallest stock width above M1

arms.label: Attention (Zoology Fig.-2 layout, d392, reference)
arms.desc: Zoology Fig.-2 MQAR attention: 2 layers, MHA 1 head, no state mixer, learned absolute positions, pre-LN, tied head, dropout 0.1; floor rule (>= M1)

arms.label: SSD R2O2 real (d248/i448)
arms.desc: SSD-MIMO R = O = 2, one real head_dynamic block, B/C gates on (real rows per coordinate), 7 heads x P 64, N 128, module defaults

arms.label: SSD R2O2 complex, new default (complex block ungated, real block gated; d248/i512)
arms.desc: SSD-MIMO R = O = 2, complex head_dynamic half (gate=False) + real head_dynamic half (gate=True), 8 heads x P 64, N 128, module defaults

arms.label: SSD R4O4 real (d176/i384)
arms.desc: SSD-MIMO R = O = 4, one real head_dynamic block, gates on, 6 heads x P 64, N 128, module defaults

arms.label: SSD R4O4 complex, new default (d208/i384)
arms.desc: SSD-MIMO R = O = 4, complex half ungated + real half gated (new default), 6 heads x P 64, N 128, module defaults

arms.label: HM A_dyn (64 A + 64 dyn real rows, no gates, d_inner 512)
arms.desc: HybridMamba, 16 head subsystems, rows 64 A real + 64 dyn real, no B/C gates, main-branch projections, trapezoid, b/c norm

arms.label: HM A_dyn_c25a
arms.desc: HybridMamba rows 48 A real + 48 dyn real + 32 A complex (25 % complex A), no gates

arms.label: HM A_dyn_c25d
arms.desc: HybridMamba rows 48 A real + 48 dyn real + 32 dyn complex (25 % complex dyn), no gates

arms.label: HM real_off (128 A real rows, no gates, d_inner 512)
arms.desc: HybridMamba, 128 A real rows (all-A real), no gates

arms.label: HM rot_off (128 A complex rows, no gates, d_inner 496)
arms.desc: HybridMamba, 128 A complex rows (all-A complex), no gates

arms.label: SSD R2O2 complex, new default, per-head ω (omega_layout head, theta_init small; d248/i512)
arms.desc: the R2O2 new-default arm (complex head_dynamic half gate=False + real head_dynamic half gate=True, 8 heads x P 64, N 128) with rotation omega_layout head (one complex eigenvalue per head) and theta_init small; same width, module defaults otherwise; replaces the per-coordinate-gated R2O2-complex-head-d224-i512 of mq-quad-insane-20260926

arms.label: SSD euler write rule (euler-insane-20260927)
arms.desc: euler-vs-trapezoid write-rule campaign; decides whether euler enters the paper
arms.pending_note: pending: euler-insane-20260927 ; wire its root/arm here when it lands
